blocks.name: Zone Surveillance
blocks.doc: Region Perimiter watch of the mission. Plug it in a drone: as long as the drone is on station, it patrols the perimeter of the field.

blocks.name: Flock Watching
blocks.doc: Region Sheep Monitoring of the mission, the watching half. Plug it in a drone: as long as the drone is on station, it counts the flock. A sheep out of the zone: it warns the operator and says so to the intelligence. It never leaves: following is the job of Sheep Tracking.

blocks.name: Sheep Tracking
blocks.doc: Region Sheep Monitoring of the mission, the following half. Plug it in a drone: it waits for a job. The job opens, it asks for it; given, the drone follows the sheep until it is back in the zone; taken, another drone has it. It sees no stray by itself: someone has to watch.

blocks.name: Predator Management
blocks.doc: Region Predator Monitoring of the mission. Plug it in a drone: thermal camera and deterrent. A bear in the tracking perimeter: it asks for the job; given, it tracks it and deters it until it has left. On a drone waiting at the base, it hears the alarm of the field.

blocks.name: Base Standby
blocks.doc: Plug it in a drone that should wait at the base instead of flying to the field: it stays docked, and takes off when one of its components gets a job. Nothing is watched from the ground: a drone with Base Standby keeps no field.

blocks.name: Swarm Master
blocks.doc: The intelligence of the swarm. Drop it once: in the Base Station, or in a drone that becomes the master. It opens the job of the stray sheep to every drone when someone spots one, gives each job (the stray sheep, the predator) to the first drone that asks and tells the others it is taken, so a drone always keeps the field.

blocks.name: Swarm Reflex
blocks.doc: The other intelligence: none. Drop one in each drone. The drone says yes to itself: every drone that sees something goes, and it calls nobody else.

blocks.name: Operator Communication
blocks.doc: Plug it in the Base Station. The link with the operator: it passes the commands of the operator app on to Ground Control, and tells the operator when the base is ready. Without it the base hears nothing, and nothing starts.

blocks.name: Weather Monitoring
blocks.doc: Plug it in the Base Station. It reads the weather station: on a storm it warns Ground Control, which calls the drones back, and tells the operator. Without it nobody watches the sky: the drones stay out in the storm.

blocks.name: Mission Monitoring
blocks.doc: Plug it in the Base Station. It passes the alerts of the drones (a sheep out, a bear, the bear gone) on to the operator. Without it the drones do their job, but nobody on the ground knows.

blocks.name: Charging Dock
blocks.doc: Plug it in the Base Station. Landing pads and chargers for up to three drones: a drone coming home asks to land, the dock clears it. Without it a drone coming home has nowhere to land.

blocks.name: Flight Orchestrator
blocks.doc: Given in every drone, not to be changed. On the order of the base station it briefs its components and takes off, unless a Base Standby keeps it docked; then it flies where its components tell it. It never asks them anything, which is why any of them can be there or not.

blocks.name: Ground Control
blocks.doc: Given in the base station, not to be changed. Distributes the flight plan, launches the drones and recalls them. It hears the operator and the weather only through the bricks of the base station, and decides nothing about who does what in flight.

blocks.name: Operator App
blocks.doc: Given. Turns the actions of the operator into commands for the base station, and shows what comes back.

blocks.name: Weather Station
blocks.doc: Given. Measures the wind on the pasture and tells the base station whether drones may fly.

blocks.name: Operator
blocks.doc: Simulation driver: the operator. The guide injects its commands here.

blocks.name: Pasture
blocks.doc: Simulation driver: what happens on the field. Every drone sees it; only the ones with the right component react.

contexts.name: Base Station
contexts.doc: The base station. Ground Control is given. Drag here what links it to the operator, the weather and the drones coming home (Operator Communication, Weather Monitoring, Mission Monitoring, Charging Dock); the Swarm Master can be dropped here too.

contexts.name: Pasture Sentinel System
contexts.doc: The system of interest of Part 4: the whole solution. The drones, the base station, the weather station and the operator app are connected; what links a drone to the intelligence depends on where you put it.

contexts.name: Swarm Simulation
contexts.doc: The system between the operator, the weather and the pasture. The guide plays the missions here.
